note: Captured from the GitHub Actions `overhead` job (ubuntu-latest, Python 3.13, CPU-only). Values are the max of two consecutive CI runs on main to absorb runner jitter; +20% regression tolerance is applied at test time. The per-primitive micro-benchmarks (scope_push_pop_us_per_cycle, mark_us_per_call, batches_us_per_iter) follow the same procedure and the same tolerance, and their gates stay dormant until a value is committed here. Only CI-runner numbers belong in this file; a developer machine's numbers would set the gate to the wrong hardware. Regenerate procedure: tests/overhead/README.md.
